title: Fliponomics
theme: Dread Pirate Robbie · night floor / stacking and flips
description: A 2026 cut on the Dread Pirate Robbie album, Fliponomics follows one trader who dresses for the full room and lives inside the live tape. Bitcoin and sats are stacked, then laid out on meme-coin tables beside a Web3 booth. A win is turned over before the candle has cooled. The suit is only costume, and the book is the whole plot.
